verdict.rationale: Base44 docs show a global style panel for colors/fonts that can be changed directly without a prompt (base44-docs-13), but the core editing workflow described elsewhere is prompt-mediated ('Ask for design options, pick the one you want. AI shows previews before it touches anything' - base44-docs-14, and instructions are sent 'straight to AI' - base44-docs-12), with no evidence of click-to-select-and-directly-edit text or layout on individual elements. Missing for 10: documented direct-manipulation editor for selecting an element and changing its text/layout inline, independent hands-on confirmation that edits bypass AI prompt round-trips.
